findings.summary: plugin PATH does not expose an executable named enterprise-harness
findings.evidence: bin/enterprise-harness.mjs is mode 100644 and portable-launcher-smoke invokes node by absolute path instead of the PATH command

findings.summary: plugin-facing reviewer and documentation agents are not all expressed as scoped subagent_type values
findings.evidence: harness design/intake/plan/verify skills and the main harness still use bare doc-research/design-reviewer/api-consistency-reviewer/plan-critic/verification-reviewer dispatch prose

findings.summary: post-add failures can bypass compensation and cleanup does not prove path, branch and captured HEAD ownership
findings.evidence: publishActiveChange calls process-exiting fail after git worktree add; cleanup uses cross-stanza substring matching and deletes a branch without revalidating captured HEAD

findings.summary: worktree smoke leaves most temporary repositories and the compensation retry worktree behind
findings.evidence: only two fixture results enter the final cleanup list

findings.summary: existing subagent-contract smoke fails and is absent from the Task 2 aggregate
findings.evidence: subagent-contract-smoke.mjs still asserts bare subtype and general-purpose wording
